desc:
🚩 Inspired by Ultimate Chicken Horse [1-12 Players]
🎉 Build the Course. Race Your Friends. Cause CHAOS!

Think you’re the smartest in the lobby? 😏
Prove it in this chaotic party game where you build the obstacles AND try to survive them!
Every round gives you a new trap, block, or boost, use it to help your friends... or DESTROY them. 💣

🏗️ Build insane levels.
🏃‍♂️ Race through chaos.
💥 Laugh as your traps go perfectly wrong.

Only one legend makes it to the goal... will it be you? 🏆
